Positional parameters: $N, $N-, $N-M, $0, trailing text after $N, and $+.
-- origin --
spec
-- script.mrc --
alias test { slap sheepy a large trout }
alias slap {
  echo -s slaps $1 around with $2-
  echo -s $2-3
  echo -s $0
  echo -s laughs at $1's joke
  echo -s Hel $+ lo th $+ ere $+ !
}
-- output --
slaps sheepy around with a large trout
a large
4
laughs at sheepy's joke
Hello there!
